Heart Doctor in Delhi NCR: Aapke Dil Ki Sehat, Hamari Zimmedari

Namaste, main Dr. Gurjeet Singh Gill hoon, ek cardiac physician. Pichle kuch saalon se main Delhi NCR aur Meerut ke aas-paas ke ilaakon mein logon ke dil ki seva kar raha hoon. Aaj main aapko kuch aise sawaalon ke jawaab dunga jo mere paas aksar patients poochte hain. Agar aap Meerut ya Delhi NCR mein rehte hain aur aapko dil se judi koi bhi problem hai, toh yeh blog aapke liye hai.

Dil ki bimariyan aaj kal bahut aam ho gayi hain, lekin sahi jankari aur samay par ilaaj se inhe control kiya ja sakta hai. Chaliye, shuru karte hain.

❓ Patient Question: "Doctor sahab, mere seene mein dard hota hai. Kya yeh heart attack hai? Mujhe kya karna chahiye?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Yeh bahut hi aam sawaal hai. Seene mein dard hamesha heart attack nahi hota, lekin ise ignore karna bilkul galat hai. Agar dard seene ke beech mein hai, dabav ya bhaari lagta hai, aur yeh dard baayein hath, jabde, ya peeth tak jaata hai, toh yeh heart attack ka lakshan ho sakta hai. Kuch logon ko saans phoolne, pasina aane, ya ulti jaisa mehsoos hota hai. Agar aapko aise lakshan hain, toh turant 108 par call karein ya nazdeeki hospital jaayein. Lekin agar dard halka hai aur kabhi-kabhi hota hai, toh bhi ise check karwana zaroori hai. Main aksar apne patients ko ECG, Echo, aur TMT test karwane ki salah deta hoon. Delhi NCR aur Meerut mein pollution, stress, aur kharab khaan-paan ki wajah se heart problems tezi se badh rahi hain. Isliye, kisi bhi tarah ke seene ke dard ko halke mein na lein. Sahi samay par jaanch se bade khatre se bacha ja sakta hai.

❓ Patient Question: "Mera BP high rehta hai. Kya mujhe hamesha dawa leni padegi? Kya ise control karne ke liye koi gharelu upay hai?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: High BP (hypertension) ko 'silent killer' kaha jaata hai kyunki yeh bina kisi lakshan ke aapke dil, kidney, aur dimaag ko nuksan pahuncha sakta hai. Agar aapka BP consistently 140/90 se upar hai, toh aksar dawa ki zaroorat padti hai. Lekin kuch cases mein lifestyle changes se bhi ise control kiya ja sakta hai. Gharelu upayon mein namak kam karein (din mein 5 gram se kam), pottassium-rich foods jaise kela, nariyal paani, palak khayein, roz 30 minute walk karein, aur stress kam karein. PM Jan Aushadhi generic medicines se aapko sasti aur asli dawa mil sakti hai. Lekin dawa shuru karne se pehle ya band karne se pehle hamesha doctor se salah lein. Main apne clinic par patients ko BP monitor karne ki salah deta hoon aur unhe sahi dawa ke saath lifestyle guidance bhi deta hoon. SPRINT Trial 2015 ke mutabiq, BP ko 120 se neeche rakhne se heart attack aur stroke ka risk kam hota hai. Isliye, BP ko ignore na karein.

❓ Patient Question: "Mera cholesterol high hai. Kya main ghee aur tel bilkul band kar doon?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Cholesterol high hone par ghee aur tel ko bilkul band karne ki zaroorat nahi hai, lekin unki matra aur quality par dhyan dena zaroori hai. Desi ghee mein saturated fat hota hai, isliye ise seemit matra mein khayein (1-2 chammach roz). Tel ke liye, mustard oil, olive oil, ya rice bran oil use karein. Trans fat wale foods jaise bakery items, packaged snacks, aur fried foods se door rahein. Indian diet mein soluble fiber badhayein - jaise oats, dal, chana, aur sabziyan. Omega-3 ke liye flaxseed, walnuts, aur machli khayein. Agar cholesterol bahut zyada hai, toh statin dawa ki zaroorat pad sakti hai. PM Jan Aushadhi se generic statins sasti milti hain. Framingham Heart Study ke anusaar, cholesterol levels aur heart disease ka seedha sambandh hai. Isliye, regular lipid profile test karwate rahein aur doctor ki salah se dawa lein.

❓ Patient Question: "Mujhe diabetes hai. Kya mera heart attack ka risk badh jaata hai? Main kya karoon?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Ji haan, diabetes heart attack ka ek bada risk factor hai. High blood sugar aapki blood vessels ko nuksan pahunchata hai, jisse atherosclerosis (arteries mein plaque jama hona) hota hai. Isliye, diabetes ko control mein rakhna bahut zaroori hai. Apne HbA1c ko 7% se neeche rakhein, BP ko 130/80 se neeche, aur LDL cholesterol ko 70 mg/dL se neeche. Regular exercise, kam carb diet, aur prescribed dawa len. SGLT2 inhibitors aur GLP-1 receptor agonists jaise naye diabetes drugs heart ke liye bhi faydemand hain. ISCHEMIA Trial 2020 ke mutabiq, stable heart disease mein pehle medical therapy try karni chahiye, lekin diabetes patients mein aggressive control zaroori hai. Main apne diabetes patients ko har 6 mahine mein heart check-up karwane ki salah deta hoon. Meerut aur Delhi NCR mein diabetes ki rate bahut zyada hai, isliye jaanch aur ilaaj samay par karein.

❓ Patient Question: "Heart attack ke baad main normal life ji sakta hoon? Kya exercise kar sakta hoon?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Bilkul! Heart attack ke baad sahi dekhbhal aur rehabilitation se aap normal life ji sakte hain. Cardiac rehab program mein exercise, diet counseling, aur stress management shamil hai. Shuru mein halki walking se shuru karein, phir dhire-dhire intensity badhayein. Apne doctor se poochein ki aapke liye kaunsi exercise safe hai. Aam taur par, hafte mein 150 minute moderate exercise ya 75 minute vigorous exercise recommended hai. Dr. Eugene Braunwald, jo duniya ke sabse bade cardiologist maane jaate hain, kehte hain ki heart attack ke baad lifestyle changes aur dawa ka palan zindagi bhar karna chahiye. Aapko tension nahi lena chahiye, kyunki stress se BP badhta hai. Apne parivaar aur doston ke saath samay bitayein. Gill Heart Clinic mein hum aise patients ko regular follow-up aur counseling dete hain. PM Jan Aushadhi se sasti dawa lein aur niyamit jaanch karwate rahein.

❓ Patient Question: "Kya main apne dil ko swasth rakhne ke liye koi gharelu nuskhe follow kar sakta hoon?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Ji haan, kuch gharelu nuskhe aur aadatein aapke dil ke liye faydemand hain. Roz subah khaali pet 1 bhiga hua lehsun khayein - yeh cholesterol kam karta hai. Arjun ki chhaal ka kadha ( herbal tea) bhi faydemand hai, lekin ise doctor ki salah se lein. Methi dana raat ko bhigo kar subah khayein - yeh sugar aur cholesterol control karta hai. Roz 30 minute yoga aur pranayam karein. Namak aur cheeni kam karein. Alcohol aur smoking bilkul band karein. Dr. Valentin Fuster, jo Mount Sinai Heart ke director hain, kehte hain ki 80% heart diseases lifestyle changes se prevent ki ja sakti hain. Isliye, apni aadatein sudharein. Lekin yaad rakhein, yeh nuskhe dawa ka vikalp nahi hain. Regular check-up aur doctor ki salah zaroori hai.

🩺 Dr. Gill's Clinical Experience

Gill Heart Clinic, Mohiuddinpur, Meerut mein maine hazaaron patients ka ilaaj kiya hai. Ek 55 saal ke kisan, Ramesh (naam badla gaya), jo roz 12 ghante kheti mein kaam karte the, unhe seene mein dard aur saans phoolne ki shikayat thi. Unka BP 180/100 tha aur ECG mein changes the. Humne unhe turant admit kiya aur angiography ki, jisme ek artery 90% blocked thi. Angioplasty ke baad woh ab bilkul theek hain aur apni kheti ka kaam kar rahe hain. Ek aur case, 42 saal ki Sunita (naam badla gaya), jo Delhi NCR mein IT company mein kaam karti thi, unhe anxiety aur palpitations thi. Unka BP aur sugar normal tha, lekin stress bahut zyada tha. Humne unhe lifestyle changes aur yoga ki salah di, aur ab woh bina dawa ke theek hain. In cases se maine seekha ki samay par jaanch aur sahi guidance se bahut bade khatre tal sakte hain.

Indian Diet and Lifestyle Advice

Indian diet mein heart-friendly changes kaise karein:

  • Namak kam karein: Achar, papad, packaged masala, aur namkeen se door rahein. Ghar ka khana taze masalon ke saath banayein.
  • Tel badlein: Mustard oil, olive oil, ya rice bran oil use karein. Deep frying se bachein.
  • Fiber badhayein: Oats, dal, chana, rajma, aur sabziyan khayein.
  • Healthy fats: Desi ghee seemit matra mein, nariyal tel, aur nuts (badam, akhrot) khayein.
  • Sugar control: Meethi cheezein kam karein, gud aur shakkar ki jagah date ya kishmish use karein.
  • Exercise: Roz 30-45 minute tez chalna, yoga, ya cycling karein.
  • Stress management: Meditation, pranayam, aur parivaar ke saath samay bitayein.
  • PM Jan Aushadhi: Generic dawa sasti aur asli hoti hai. Apne nazdeeki Jan Aushadhi store se lein.

FAQ

Q: Kya heart doctor Delhi NCR mein dekhne ke liye Meerut se aana padega?

A: Nahi, Dr. Gurjeet Singh Gill Gill Heart Clinic, Mohiuddinpur, Meerut mein hi available hain. Aap yahan appointment le sakte hain. Delhi NCR se Meerut aana aasan hai.

Q: Heart check-up ke liye kaunse test karwane chahiye?

A: Basic tests mein ECG, Echo, TMT, lipid profile, blood sugar, aur BP monitoring shamil hain. Agar zaroorat ho toh angiography bhi ki ja sakti hai.

Q: Kya heart attack ke baad dawa hamesha leni padegi?

A: Zyadatar cases mein haan, lekin doctor aapki condition ke hisaab se dawa kam ya band kar sakte hain. Bina salah dawa band na karein.

Q: Kya main Jan Aushadhi se heart ki dawa le sakta hoon?

A: Ji haan, Jan Aushadhi generic medicines safe aur effective hoti hain. Lekin unhe doctor ki salah se hi lein.
